name: Yonaga Angie
source:
"Angie just lends her body. The one who actually does it is god. Nyahahaha! Pretty divine, right?"

Believing that the "god of the island" is always at her side, she’s a girl with a pious heart. She can work with drawings, sculptures, and so on, but she’s known to say that "the one who is really creating everything is god." Angie has a positive personality yet does things her own way. She also has the eccentric habit of freely using her own original Japanese, like "byeyonara" or "strange miracle".

She also has a strange side–rather than showing off her pictures, she searches for things to offer as blood sacrifices, proclaims her god’s reasoning on their behalf, and so on. According to Angie, it is a tradition on her island to give some blood - or even larger amounts of it - to their god, and the sacrifice truck, which collects the said blood sacrifices, comes around on Mondays and Wednesdays.

[Edited from [url=http://jinjojess.tumblr.com/post/154469818636/ndrv3-famitsu-info-for-december-15th-2016]jinjojess' translation[/url]]
